# Rotten apple: a sickly grey ball 0.38 m across with big dark mould patches (light enough to read against the dark fence).
# Origin at the fruit's centre (a game bone pool: the game drops, catches and pops it).
new
material new Body --base-color 0.5255 0.5059 0.5333 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.2941 0.2549 0.3451 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fruit --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.19 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.92
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name Stalk --size 1 --location 0.02 0 0.225
scale 0.06 0.06 0.14
apply --scale
material assign Stem
material new Mould --base-color 0.3059 0.3451 0.2902 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name M0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.11 --location -0.08 -0.14 0.05
material assign Mould
add mesh ico-sphere --name M1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1 --location 0.11 -0.11 -0.07
material assign Mould
add mesh ico-sphere --name M2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.09 --location 0.13 0.1 0.08
material assign Mould
select all
active Fruit
join
select all
shade flat
export rotten.glb
